purpose: minimal additive, versioned extension for ground-derived coordinates and candidate ground boxes
hard_rules: do NOT change any frozen field meaning: keep coordinate.source_frame, coordinate.reference_frame, coordinate.horizontal_basis, coordinate.ground_frame, coordinate.ground_relative_available, coordinate.transform_status semantics exactly as in INTERACTION_CONTRACT v1
do NOT write the ground transform into measured-extrinsics fields (T_reference_lidar, rotations, extrinsics_verified stay as HF-03 left them; frames.reference stays null)
all additions are optional; absence means the old behaviour; presence never implies a verified physical pose
HF-01 health/manifest v1 are untouched; bump schema_version only if a frozen field meaning/enum changes, not for additive optional fields

fields.ground_derived_id: stable hash id of (n,d,R,t,ROI,source data hash)
fields.x_reference_axis_source: confirmed source reference axis used for u
fields.convention: o=-d*n; u=proj(a); v=n x u; R=[u;v;n]; horizontal heading/origin are conventions
fields.valid_region_ground_local: ROI bounds + point count for coverage checks

per_candidate.bbox_ground_min_m: [x,y,z] or null; min over the candidate's ACTUAL transformed points
per_candidate.center_ground_m: [x,y,z] or null; center of the same actual transformed points
per_candidate.bbox_ground_from: actual_points | unavailable (never from only the source min/max two corners)

coordinate_additions.ground_derived_id: which ground_derived artifact produced the ground box; null if none
coordinate_additions.note: the existing coordinate.ground_frame string is LEFT AS IS; do not repurpose it as the transform id

C_frontend_same_version_consumption: enable ground mode only when snapshot's ground_derived_id matches the loaded ground artifact
physical_verified=false => label the view unverified/preview; never show as calibrated world coordinates
unknown/missing/newer fields => ignore and fall back to source view; never default to valid/green
2D selection rectangle from the same ground AABB eight corners; selection still sends source snapshot_id/candidate_id, not pixels
D_recalibration_invalidation: a new ground_derived_id/calibration_version invalidates old snapshots, positions and standing-baseline eligibility
source seq/stamp_secs/stamp_nsecs/time_epoch are preserved and compared unchanged
monitoring checks only regions with trusted ground support; insufficient support => unknown/degraded; sustained change => require recalibration (no claim of full yaw/horizontal drift detection)
